title: Scout APM configuration
markdownDescription:
Configuration for Scout APM, an application performance monitoring (APM) service for Ruby applications.

Settings are grouped under top-level keys named after the application environment (e.g. `production`, `development`). YAML anchors and merge keys (`<<: *defaults`) can be used to share common settings.

Configure via `config/scout_apm.yml` or environment variables (prefix config keys with `SCOUT_` and uppercase).

Supports ERB templating for dynamic values.

[Scout APM Ruby Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration)

name.markdownDescription:
Name of the application displayed in Scout APM.

Default: the framework application name (for Rails, derived from `Rails.application.class`), or `App`

Example: `'Photos App'` or `'ProjectPlanner.io (#{Rails.env})'`

**Tip:** Include environment in the name to treat each environment as a separate app in Scout.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_NAME`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#common-configurations)

key.markdownDescription:
The organization API key for Scout APM.

**Required**

Find your API key in your Scout account's install instructions.

**Security:** Use ERB to load from credentials:
```yaml
key: <%= Rails.application.credentials.dig(:scout, :key) %>
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_KEY`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#common-configurations)

monitor.markdownDescription:
Enable/disable monitoring.

**Required**

Default: `false`

Set to `true` in production to enable monitoring. Typically `false` in development/test.

Example:
```yaml
production:
  monitor: true
development:
  monitor: false
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_MONITOR`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#common-configurations)

auto_instruments.markdownDescription:
Enable Auto Instruments for custom code.

Default: `false`

When enabled, Scout automatically instruments methods in your custom code beyond the default library instrumentation.

Use `auto_instruments_ignore` to exclude specific files.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_AUTO_INSTRUMENTS`

[Auto Instruments Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/features#auto-instruments)

log_level.markdownDescription:
Logging level for the Scout APM agent. Case-insensitive; unrecognised values fall back to `info`.

Default: `info`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_LOG_LEVEL`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#common-configurations)

detailed_middleware.markdownDescription:
Show individual middleware timing in transaction traces.

Default: `false`

When `true`, shows time spent in each middleware separately. When `false`, shows aggregate time across all middlewares.

**Note:** Adds overhead. Disable unless middleware is a bottleneck.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DETAILED_MIDDLEWARE`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

hostname.markdownDescription:
Custom hostname/node name for this server.

Default: `Socket.gethostname` (on Heroku, the `DYNO` environment variable)

Useful for renaming servers in Scout's UI.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_HOSTNAME`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

revision_sha.markdownDescription:
Git SHA for deployment tracking.

Links deployments to specific code versions in Scout.

Default: Auto-detected from git, Heroku, or Capistrano.

Example: `<%= `git rev-parse HEAD`.chomp %>`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_REVISION_SHA`

[Deploy Tracking Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/features/#deploy-tracking)

scm_subdirectory.markdownDescription:
Relative path from Git repo root to application code directory.

Useful for monorepos where app code is in a subdirectory.

Example: `'backend/api'`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_SCM_SUBDIRECTORY`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

sample_rate.markdownDescription:
Global sample rate for all requests and jobs.

Default: `1` (capture 100% of requests)

Range: `0.0-1.0` (fraction of requests to capture). Values above `1` are treated as a percentage for backwards compatibility (e.g. `80` is `0.8`).

Example: `0.8` captures 80% of requests, reducing overhead.

**Note:** Since 6.0, a rate of exactly 1% must be written as `0.01`, since `1` means 100%.

**Note:** Overridden by `endpoint_sample_rate`, `job_sample_rate`, `sample_endpoints`, and `sample_jobs`.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_SAMPLE_RATE`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

endpoint_sample_rate.markdownDescription:
Sample rate for all web endpoints.

Default: not set (falls back to `sample_rate`)

Range: `0.0-1.0` (fraction of requests). Values above `1` are treated as a percentage.

Overrides `sample_rate` for endpoints. Use `sample_endpoints` for per-endpoint rates.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ENDPOINT_SAMPLE_RATE`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

job_sample_rate.markdownDescription:
Sample rate for all background jobs.

Default: not set (falls back to `sample_rate`)

Range: `0.0-1.0` (fraction of jobs). Values above `1` are treated as a percentage.

Overrides `sample_rate` for jobs. Use `sample_jobs` for per-job rates.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_JOB_SAMPLE_RATE`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

ignore_endpoints.markdownDescription:
Web endpoints to exclude from monitoring.

Default: `[]`

Each entry is a path prefix, interpreted as a regular expression anchored at the start of the URI.

Example:
```yaml
ignore_endpoints:
  - '/health'
  - '/status'
  - '/admin/metrics'
```

**Note:** Replaces deprecated `ignore` configuration.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_IGNORE_ENDPOINTS`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

ignore_jobs.markdownDescription:
Background job names to exclude from monitoring.

Default: `[]`

Jobs with exact name match will be ignored.

Example:
```yaml
ignore_jobs:
  - HealthCheckJob
  - CleanupJob
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_IGNORE_JOBS`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

sample_endpoints.markdownDescription:
Per-endpoint sample rates.

Default: `[]`

Format: `['endpoint_path:rate']` where rate is `0.0-1.0` (values above `1` are treated as a percentage). Endpoints are matched by path prefix.

Overrides `endpoint_sample_rate` for matching endpoints.

Example:
```yaml
sample_endpoints:
  - '/api/heavy_endpoint:0.5'
  - '/api/light_endpoint:1'
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_SAMPLE_ENDPOINTS`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

sample_jobs.markdownDescription:
Per-job sample rates.

Default: `[]`

Format: `['JobName:rate']` where rate is `0.0-1.0` (values above `1` are treated as a percentage). Jobs are matched by exact name.

Overrides `job_sample_rate` for matching jobs.

Example:
```yaml
sample_jobs:
  - 'HeavyProcessingJob:0.5'
  - 'QuickJob:1'
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_SAMPLE_JOBS`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

max_traces.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of traces to collect per reporting period.

Default: `10`

**Internal:** this also requires a server-side setting; raising it makes your app server work harder for no benefit.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_MAX_TRACES`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

enable_background_jobs.markdownDescription:
Enable/disable background job monitoring.

Default: `true`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ENABLE_BACKGROUND_JOBS`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

collect_remote_ip.markdownDescription:
Capture end user IP addresses in trace context.

Default: `true`

**Privacy:** Disable if IP collection violates privacy requirements.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_COLLECT_REMOTE_IP`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

record_queue_time.markdownDescription:
Capture request queue time from HTTP headers.

Default: `true`

Requires `X-Queue-Start` or `X-Request-Start` header from your web server/load balancer.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_RECORD_QUEUE_TIME`

[Queue Time Setup](https://scoutapm.com/docs/features#setup)

auto_instruments_ignore.markdownDescription:
Files to exclude from Auto Instruments.

Default: `[]`

Provide file names (without `.rb` extension) to exclude from automatic instrumentation.

Example:
```yaml
auto_instruments_ignore:
  - application_controller
  - base_model
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_AUTO_INSTRUMENTS_IGNORE`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

errors_ignored_exceptions.markdownDescription:
Exception classes to exclude from error monitoring.

Default: `[ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, ActionController::RoutingError]`

Example:
```yaml
errors_ignored_exceptions:
  - ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
  - ActionController::RoutingError
  - CustomNotFoundError
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ERRORS_IGNORED_EXCEPTIONS`

[Error Monitoring Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/error-monitoring)

errors_filtered_params.markdownDescription:
Parameter names to filter in error reports.

Default: `[password, s3-key]`

Sensitive parameter values will be redacted from error context.

Example:
```yaml
errors_filtered_params:
  - password
  - credit_card
  - api_key
```

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ERRORS_FILTERED_PARAMS`

[Error Monitoring Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/error-monitoring)

log_file_path.markdownDescription:
Directory in which Scout APM writes its `scout_apm.log` file.

Default: `<application root>/log` (or `STDOUT` on Heroku and Cloud Foundry)

Set to `STDOUT` or `STDERR` (case-insensitive) to log to standard output or standard error instead of a file. If the directory is not writable, logs go to STDOUT.

Example: `/var/log/my_app`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_LOG_FILE_PATH`

[Logging Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/logging)

proxy.markdownDescription:
Proxy URL for Scout APM agent connections.

Required only if your network requires a proxy.

Example: `https://proxy.example.com:8080`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_PROXY`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

host.markdownDescription:
Scout APM reporting endpoint.

Default: `https://checkin.scoutapp.com`

Only change if instructed by Scout support.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_HOST`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

markdownEnumDescriptions: Report URL with query parameters (sensitive params redacted) - default
Report URL with query parameters (sensitive params redacted) - same as `full_path`
Report URL path only, exclude all query parameters

uri_reporting.markdownDescription:
Control how URLs are reported in transaction traces.

Default: `full_path`

- `full_path` (or any value other than `path`) - Include query params with sensitive values redacted
- `path` - Exclude query params entirely

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_URI_REPORTING`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

disabled_instruments.markdownDescription:
Instrument classes to disable.

Default: `[]`

Provide case-sensitive class names of instruments to not install.

Example:
```yaml
disabled_instruments:
  - Elasticsearch
  - HttpClient
  - Redis
```

[Available Instruments](https://github.com/scoutapp/scout_apm_ruby/tree/master/lib/scout_apm/instruments)

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTS`

[Configuration Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#additional-configurations)

timeline_traces.markdownDescription:
Send traces in both summary and timeline formats.

Default: `true`

Enables the detailed timeline view in Scout's UI.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_TIMELINE_TRACES`

[Timeline View Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/features#timeline-view)

use_prepend.markdownDescription:
Use `Module#prepend` for instrumentation instead of `alias_method`.

Default: `false`

**Note:** Switching can help avoid conflicts with other gems but may cause issues. Test thoroughly.

Use `prepend_instruments` or `alias_method_instruments` for selective control.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_USE_PREPEND`

[Library Instrumentation Method Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#library-instrumentation-method)

alias_method_instruments.markdownDescription:
Instruments to use `alias_method` when `use_prepend` is `true`.

Default: `[]`

Selectively override `use_prepend` for specific instruments.

Example:
```yaml
use_prepend: true
alias_method_instruments:
  - Elasticsearch
  - HttpClient
```

[Available Instruments](https://github.com/scoutapp/scout_apm_ruby/tree/master/lib/scout_apm/instruments)

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ALIAS_METHOD_INSTRUMENTS`

[Library Instrumentation Method Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#library-instrumentation-method)

prepend_instruments.markdownDescription:
Instruments to use `Module#prepend` when `use_prepend` is `false`.

Default: `[]`

Selectively use `prepend` for specific instruments when `alias_method` is the default.

Example:
```yaml
use_prepend: false
prepend_instruments:
  - Redis
  - MongoDB
```

[Available Instruments](https://github.com/scoutapp/scout_apm_ruby/tree/master/lib/scout_apm/instruments)

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_PREPEND_INSTRUMENTS`

[Library Instrumentation Method Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/configuration#library-instrumentation-method)

application_root.markdownDescription:
Override the detected root directory of the application.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_APPLICATION_ROOT`

async_recording.markdownDescription:
Record transactions asynchronously in a background thread instead of synchronously at the end of each request.

Default: `false`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ASYNC_RECORDING`

backtrace_additional_directories.markdownDescription:
Additional directories (relative to the application root) to include when parsing backtraces, beyond `lib/`, `app/` and `config/`.

Default: `[]`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_BACKTRACE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES`

compress_payload.markdownDescription:
Gzip payloads sent to Scout.

Default: `true`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_COMPRESS_PAYLOAD`

data_file.markdownDescription:
Override the default temporary storage location for collected data. Must be in a writable directory; if a file path is given, its directory is used.

Default: the application's `tmp/` directory, falling back to `/tmp`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DATA_FILE`

database_metric_limit.markdownDescription:
Hard limit on the number of database query metrics tracked.

Default: `5000`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DATABASE_METRIC_LIMIT`

database_metric_report_limit.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of database query metrics reported per period.

Default: `1000`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DATABASE_METRIC_REPORT_LIMIT`

dev_trace.markdownDescription:
Enable DevTrace, always-on tracing displayed in the browser, in the development environment only.

Default: `false`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DEV_TRACE`

direct_host.markdownDescription:
Override the "direct" host, which bypasses the ingestion pipeline. Primarily used for features under development.

Default: `https://apm.scoutapp.com`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_DIRECT_HOST`

errors_enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable Scout's error monitoring service.

Default: `false`

[Error Monitoring Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/error-monitoring)

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ERRORS_ENABLED`

errors_env_capture.markdownDescription:
Additional Rack environment keys to capture in error reports.

Default: `[]`

[Error Monitoring Documentation](https://scoutapm.com/docs/ruby/error-monitoring)

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ERRORS_ENV_CAPTURE`

errors_host.markdownDescription:
Host that error reports are sent to.

Default: `https://errors.scoutapm.com`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_ERRORS_HOST`

external_service_metric_limit.markdownDescription:
Hard limit on the number of external service metrics tracked.

Default: `5000`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_EXTERNAL_SERVICE_METRIC_LIMIT`

external_service_metric_report_limit.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of external service metrics reported per period.

Default: `1000`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_EXTERNAL_SERVICE_METRIC_REPORT_LIMIT`

instrument_http_url_length.markdownDescription:
Maximum length of URLs recorded by HTTP client instruments (Net::HTTP, HTTPClient, HTTPX, Typhoeus, etc).

Default: `300`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_INSTRUMENT_HTTP_URL_LENGTH`

job_params_capture.markdownDescription:
Capture Sidekiq job arguments as context.

Default: `false`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_JOB_PARAMS_CAPTURE`

job_filtered_params.markdownDescription:
Job argument names to filter out of captured job arguments (see `job_params_capture`). Rails' `filter_parameters` are always included.

Default: `[]`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_JOB_FILTERED_PARAMS`

log_class.markdownDescription:
Ruby logger class to use for the agent's log, e.g. a custom `Logger` subclass.

Default: `Logger`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_LOG_CLASS`

log_stdout.markdownDescription:
Force the agent's log to be written to STDOUT (overrides `log_file_path`).

Default: `false` (`true` on Heroku and Cloud Foundry)

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_LOG_STDOUT`

log_stderr.markdownDescription:
Force the agent's log to be written to STDERR (overrides `log_file_path`).

Default: `false`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_LOG_STDERR`

remote_agent_host.markdownDescription:
**Internal:** host the remote agent server binds to and that forked workers (e.g. Resque) report to.

Default: `127.0.0.1`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_REMOTE_AGENT_HOST`

remote_agent_port.markdownDescription:
Port the remote agent server binds to.

Default: `7721`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_REMOTE_AGENT_PORT`

report_format.markdownDescription:
Payload format sent to Scout. `marshal` is legacy.

Default: `json`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_REPORT_FORMAT`

ssl_cert_file.markdownDescription:
Path to the CA certificate bundle used when reporting to Scout.

Default: the bundled `data/cacert.pem`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_SSL_CERT_FILE`

start_resque_server_instrument.markdownDescription:
Start the remote agent server used to instrument forking Resque workers. Only applies when Resque is detected.

Default: `true`

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_START_RESQUE_SERVER_INSTRUMENT`

ignore.markdownDescription:
**Deprecated:** use `ignore_endpoints` instead. If set, takes precedence over `ignore_endpoints`.

**Env Var:** `SCOUT_IGNORE`
